syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 1. Evolution of Indian Administration: Kautilya's Arthashastra; Mughal administration; Legacy of British rule in politics and administration - Indianization of public services, revenue administration, district administration, local self-government.
micro_themes: Legacy of British rule in politics and administration
District administration and local self-government under colonial rule

syllabus_nodes.macro_topic: 2 Philosophical and Constitutional framework of government
syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 2. Philosophical and Constitutional framework of government: Salient features and value premises; Constitutionalism; Political culture; Bureaucracy and democracy; Bureaucracy and development.
micro_themes: Salient features and value premises of the Constitution

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 3. Public Sector Undertakings: Public sector in modern India; Forms of Public Sector Undertakings; Problems of autonomy, accountability and control; Impact of liberalization and privatization.
micro_themes: Problems of autonomy, accountability and control

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 4. Union Government and Administration: Executive, Parliament, Judiciary - structure, functions, work processes; Recent trends; Intragovernmental relations; Cabinet Secretariat; Prime Minister's Office; Central Secretariat; Ministries and Departments; Boards; Commissions; Attached offices; Field organizations.
micro_themes: Executive, Parliament and Judiciary: structure, functions and work processes
Cabinet Secretariat and the Prime Minister's Office

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 5. Plans and Priorities: Machinery of planning; Role, composition and functions of the Planning Commission and the National Development Council; 'Indicative' planning; Process of plan formulation at Union and State levels; Constitutional Amendments (1992) and decentralized planning for economic development and social justice.
micro_themes: Planning Commission and the National Development Council; NITI Aayog
Process of plan formulation at Union and State levels
Constitutional Amendments of 1992 and decentralized planning

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 6. State Government and Administration: Union-State administrative, legislative and financial relations; Role of the Finance Commission; Governor; Chief Minister; Council of Ministers; Chief Secretary; State Secretariat; Directorates.
micro_themes: Union-State administrative, legislative and financial relations
Council of Ministers and the Chief Secretary

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 7. District Administration since Independence: Changing role of the Collector; Union-State-local relations; Imperatives of development management and law and order administration; District administration and democratic decentralization.
micro_themes: Development management and law and order administration

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 8. Civil Services: Constitutional position; Structure, recruitment, training and capacity-building; Good governance initiatives; Code of conduct and discipline; Staff associations; Political rights; Grievance redressal mechanism; Civil service neutrality; Civil service activism.
micro_themes: Constitutional position of the civil services
Civil service neutrality and civil service activism

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 9. Financial Management: Budget as a political instrument; Parliamentary control of public expenditure; Role of finance ministry in monetary and fiscal area; Accounting techniques; Audit; Role of Controller General of Accounts and Comptroller and Auditor General of India.
micro_themes: Role of the Finance Ministry in monetary and fiscal policy
Controller General of Accounts and Comptroller and Auditor General of India

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 10. Administrative Reforms since Independence: Major concerns; Important Committees and Commissions; Reforms in financial management and human resource development; Problems of implementation.
micro_themes: Important committees and commissions on administrative reform

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 11. Rural Development: Institutions and agencies since Independence; Rural development programmes - foci and strategies; Decentralization and Panchayati Raj; 73rd Constitutional amendment.
micro_themes: Rural development institutions and agencies since Independence
Rural development programmes: foci and strategies

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 12. Urban Local Government: Municipal governance - main features, structures, finance and problem areas; 74th Constitutional Amendment; Global-local debate; New localism; Development dynamics, politics and administration with special reference to city management.
micro_themes: Municipal governance: main features, structures and finance
Development dynamics, politics and administration in city management

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 13. Law and Order Administration: British legacy; National Police Commission; Investigative agencies; Role of Central and State Agencies including paramilitary forces in maintenance of law and order and countering insurgency and terrorism; Criminalisation of politics and administration; Police-public relations; Reforms in Police.
micro_themes: British legacy in law and order administration
Central and State agencies and paramilitary forces in law and order

syllabus_nodes.official_syllabus_line: 14. Significant issues in Indian Administration: Values in public service; Regulatory Commissions; National Human Rights Commission; Problems of administration in coalition regimes; Citizen-administration interface; Corruption and administration; Disaster management.
micro_themes: Problems of administration in coalition regimes
